title: rift-ds token values
description: The resolved value of every semantic token, per theme and per mode, as src/tokens/values.json ships it. Generated by scripts/generate-token-values.mjs from the token CSS and the preset composer.

//.description: The generated-file notice: which script writes the file and how to regenerate it.

themes.description: One entry per shipped theme, keyed by theme id: the base look first, then every preset in the selector order.

valueMap.description: Semantic token name to its resolved literal CSS value.

light.description: Every semantic token's value in light mode.

dark.description: Every semantic token's value in dark mode.

media.description: Per @media prelude (without the @media keyword), only the tokens whose light-mode value differs inside that block.
